content: Hired player who covers William's parts during illness
He will take the current word, and he will not take the reason with it.
He dries in one place and apologises to a different man each time; on Friday he came through once and apologised to nobody.
He can carry a part, and this week he does not. He does not ask which cut stands. Monday can mind Monday.
He comes as far as the stair allows, and he will not carry a reason off the step.
